\begin{theorem}[Polynomially Scaled Verifier Time Bound]
\lean{BoolCircuit.verifier_time_le}
\label{BoolCircuit.verifier_time_le}
\leanok
\difficulty{4}
For all natural numbers $n,C,c,C_V,d$, one has
$C_V\bigl(n+C(n+1)^c+1\bigr)^d\leq\bigl(C_V(C+1)^d+1\bigr)(n+1)^{(c+1)d}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[List reconstruction from indexed values]
\lean{BoolCircuit.ofFn_getD_eq}
\label{BoolCircuit.ofFn_getD_eq}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
Let $u$ be a Boolean list of length $m$. The list of values obtained by querying $u$ at
each index from $0$ through $m-1$, using `false` as the default value, is exactly $u$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Circuit satisfiability is NP-hard]
\lean{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPHard}
\label{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPHard}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.eval, BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang, BoolCircuit.encode_mem_dagCktSatLang_iff, BoolCircuit.mem_dagCktSat_iff, BoolCircuit.ofFn_getD_eq, BoolCircuit.verifier_time_le, Complexity.NPHard, Complexity.PolyTimeComputable.comp, Complexity.UTab.polyTimeComputable_tabEmit, Complexity.UTab.tabEmit, Complexity.UTab.tabEmit_eq, Complexity.cfgTab, Complexity.cfgTab_eval, Complexity.cfgTab_isFaninTwo, Complexity.decide_emits_eq_of_computesInTime, Complexity.mem_P_iff, Complexity.polyTimeComputable_id, Complexity.polyTimeComputable_polyUnary, Complexity.polyTimeComputable_tabInput, Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime.mono, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator}
\difficulty{5}
Every language in NP is polynomial-time many-one reducible to the language of valid
encodings of satisfiable Boolean directed acyclic circuits in which every gate has at
most two inputs.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Circuit satisfiability is NP-complete]
\lean{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPComplete}
\label{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPComplete}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang, BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPHard, BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_mem_NP, Complexity.NPComplete}
\difficulty{1}
The language of valid encodings of satisfiable Boolean directed acyclic circuits in
which every gate has at most two inputs is NP-complete: it belongs to NP, and every
language in NP is polynomial-time many-one reducible to it.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[NP-hardness of serialized 3-CNF satisfiability]
\lean{Complexity.SAT3_NPHard_viaCircuits}
\label{Complexity.SAT3_NPHard_viaCircuits}
\leanok
\uses{BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_NPHard, BoolCircuit.dagCktSatLang_polyTimeReducible_SAT3, Complexity.NPHard, Complexity.PolyTimeReducible.trans, Complexity.SAT3}
\difficulty{1}
Let $\mathrm{SAT}_3$ be the language of bit strings whose decoded CNF formula is
satisfiable and has at most three literals in every clause. Every language in NP has a
polynomial-time many-one reduction to $\mathrm{SAT}_3$.
\end{theorem}
